title: Sleepy squirrel
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- bushy tail, curled behind -->
  <path d='M64 80 C86 84 94 64 86 48 C80 36 68 34 62 44 C72 44 76 54 70 62 C66 68 60 70 56 72 Z' fill='#c9773b'/>

  <ellipse cx='46' cy='68' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#d98a4e'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='73' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#f2cf9e'/>

  <ellipse cx='36' cy='85' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#b96a33'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='85' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#b96a33'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='44' r='17' fill='#d98a4e'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M32 32 L30 20 L40 28 Z' fill='#d98a4e'/>
  <path d='M56 32 L58 20 L48 28 Z' fill='#d98a4e'/>
  <path d='M33 30 L32 24 L37 28 Z' fill='#f2b48a'/>
  <path d='M55 30 L56 24 L51 28 Z' fill='#f2b48a'/>

  <path d='M34 43 Q38 47 42 43' fill='none' stroke='#7a3f17' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M46 43 Q50 47 54 43' fill='none' stroke='#7a3f17' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <circle cx='57' cy='50' r='3.5' fill='#f2a586'/>
  <!-- front paws together, tucked -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='62' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#f2cf9e'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#f2cf9e'/>

  <path d='M68 26 L74 26 L68 32 L74 32' fill='none' stroke='#8fd6ff' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
